# my works

- g0ne, fl1nch, 2▽22;d, m3ss, P;ZZ4Z, 5. (012345) (2023): I have no mouth, but I must scream. However, I do have a vibraphone, a score with words, and a way to deal with the monsters that caused those night terrors.
- 4 Seasons (x2) (2021): Collection of orchestral tracks inspired by the shifting seasons. Not sponsored by the hotel.
- 5 Cuppas, with love (2019): Made for my music course, specifically 5C, with love in spite of how I sometimes fight with western music theory standards.
- A summation of 4/20(/20) (2020): mental breakdown at the beginning of my birthmonth and the start of the pandemic lockdown.
- BIXE.in / DIVE.in (2019): Plucky ostinato driver that guides you through a waterway filled with more than what you bargained for.
- blind dating (2020): Children serenade you, choreography included, about the incompatibilites of your heart and brain.
- block, the noun (2022): Creative block drives one to write about it literally and turn it into a song in hopes that it will unblock the block
- Bossbot HQ ver 5 (2021): Harpsichord and strict rhythms, straight and square as the cogs intended it to be.
- brain dormant & suspenselessly magpietyish “oh geez do not abbreviate this title i'm sorry” (2021): writer has another mental breakdown and temporarily exists in three different worlds with varying personalities and skillsets but the same amount of hatred.
- Brass Jungle (2025): Orchestral composer experiments with electronic works while in transit during a time of lots of movement.
- Brrrgh Suite (2026): 3 tracks covering ambient music in the Brrrgh, a snowy but surely cheerful place.
- C’est la vie (2012): a young pianist's very first composition, with a title based off of a random phrase seen at random. the result is a waltz.
- CALPIRG ✨ (2020): Fusing a hatred for slimy interest groups that do not stop nagging you as you pass by in a rush, and a love for the mission they have.
- cannot vibe (2019): Four percussionists hate each other, the festival season, and the sets of songs for festival. Eight hand, sixteen mallet setup.
- cat major (2021): pianist attempting to practice a song in an annoying key gets interrupted by a cat that really insists on contributing
- Cinnamon / and its variants (2018): Waltz that came to me one morning that reminded me of the warmth of the flavor. Spawned several versions thereafter for unknown reasons, though appreciated.
- Cyclic (2018): composer's first landscape-inspired piece, multimovement. also composer's first exposure to composing for instruments they haven't played before, either
- Daisy Gardens Suite (2025): Two re-arrangements of timeless classical pieces to capture the sophistry of Daisy's Gardens.
- Delfino Plaza mais plus déroutante (2020): Themes and variation piece that breaks Super Mario Sunshine's primary theme into four parts over five variations
- demmo (“bon temps”) (2021): Interactive piece with intro and outro as needed. You can tell the composer wrote this in winter.
- Desert Sandbox (2019): Interactive piece set in Wwise's desert, vertically composed with aleatory (chance) considerations
- die Gänsetanzen (2020): The Goosedance describes a person who hates geese so much that they made a track making fun of them.
- Donald's Dreamland Suite (2022): Collection of three tracks to co-incide with the three areas in Donald's Dreamland (playground, street, building.)
- Drive (2019): Rant song with a vocalist and her band as she describes why she hates driving for a particular company, whose CEO is named.
- Enmity (2018): Angry piano piece inspired by metal music gets scored for metal and turned back into a piano piece. Features a Shepherd's tone.
- EXISTENTIAL 3-18-9-19-9-19 : ☺♫↑○♣¶↓ (EXISTENTIAL 77) (2025): Composer combines the following special interests: aviation, air traffic control, amen break, (an attempt at) breakcore, 7/8
- facing death (Existential Treads) (2021): Inspired by a comic strip so delightfully absurd that a composer made a song with the text.
- Familiarity (2023): Guitar duo track depicting calm and resolute optimism, with a major sense of unexplained familiarity behind it.
- Fire (2019): Vocalist duets with clarinet (or other singer) to express angst against someone or something else.
- Flowers (2018): SATB (four-part soprano, alto, tenor, bass) choir singing about children at recess distressing some flowers.
- früt loups (DOES NOT LOOP) (2021): Vertically composed track that turns more tracks on as the player progresses through the stage; static version adapted for Toontown
- full of shift, pebble (2019): Solo ukulele piece written in a rush, full of shifts as Sophie learns to play the uke, eventually adapted for percussion.
- Fur Dich (2018): Delusional singer vocalizes about how their target of affection will eventually love them one day. Incredibly ballsy composition from a person who hadn't yet composed anything with lyrics, or had experience participating in musical theater.
- Gener;c (2019): Ostinato-forward piece arriving at the same time the composer learns about bass flute, which results in a desire to duet it with a real flute.
- get ready (2018): Composer learns about brass ensembles for the first time, then proceeds to use it like a game about breaking hearts.
- Inception (2021): Rescore of the rotating scene, without the crashes because I didn't know what to do with that and I wanted a fighting montage. Also works as boss music.
- inter.explor.atory (2020): A horizontally composed track whose inspiration started in the idea of exploring a forest and ended with coping with loss.in
- iustitia nunquam moritur (2019): Counterpoint chorale featuring a court transcript of a woman who is inconsistent about her son's age.
- Laura’s song / red paint on white carpet (2018): Piano composition dedicated to Sophie's first piano teacher who encouraged her to compose.
- Legends of IdleOn set (2021): TODO: write a summary for a stranger who has never heard this piece. At least eighty characters.
- Linehan 4:4-5 (2026): Emotions before, during, and after having to read emotional falsehoods that should be switched in exchange for their truthful counterparts.
- Ludopastiche (Album) (2024): 24 work days to make 24 songs from 24 different games, both inspired by yet not a direct copy of every single one of them.
- Memorial for Mr. Unpleasant (from avwd) (2019): memorial for an unpleasant person and actor, from a very weird dream. Piano composition based on that weird dream, followed by learning about the pandemic lockdown.
- Morning hours (2019): Night owl struggles between her love for watching the sun rise on days she must wake up early, and grogginess of having to do that.
- my great grate song (2019): Cheesy song with as many puns about cheese as one can fit into a meta song about cheese.
- Past present future [ppf] (2019): Thoughts on the influence of the past showing itself in the present, and how the future will be shaped by the two of those.
- pov: college grad in charge of aol dial up tone-up (2021): Contemporary work based off 12-tone serialism that borrows the number sequence from Kiss Me Thru the Phone,=,
- Precipice (2021): Are you going to just stand there, or will you take the leap? Series of thoughts when standing on the edge of a cliff.
- “River at one point” (2019): Stream of consciousness-style composition between viola and piano, much alike a river that poses no threat nor stands still.
- S.C.B (2019): what if music were bees? what if title was bees? vocalist experiences bees in highly unusual places and has a beek down as a result
- Salt and Snow (2019): The cold and the snow mix with the composer's tears (salt) to make a broody ostinato song.
- sans dormir (2019): Person without sleep desperately tries to ask the Sandman to help with falling asleep, only to end up in some nightmare state.
- Skeleton Walk (2020): Skeletons jam using their natural gift of percussion (their bones). Features a Tetris bit somewhere if you listen or watch it.
- ************** (2018): No emotions, very numb and angry, lost in the world, tritone aficiandos rejoice with this one.
- Te-opt (2020): short, quick optimistic little tune trying to find the happiness and power to persist through the lockdown (after coming down from the shock)
- Tenacity / Tenac;ty (2019): softened and dampened harp that guides you into a cold, quiet place. in spite of the chaotic middle, you still make it out alive.
- the law (2020): Redd is cornered by Isabelle and Tom Nook for over intent to sell forged art pieces to unsuspecting villagers.
- tiny tin man (2019): Song making fun of someone who is short in stature, and regretting it (the small person has lots of pent up rage)
- tortilla chips (2021): Brain fog plus hunger equals wanting to smash one's head into a bowl of salsa before realizing that it is spicy
- Unreachable (2018): Angry, chaotic song where performers are grateful that breath is not required for any of the instruments listed, plus Bach for funsies.
- Ursus Amare Arctos, Fiat Arctos! (2019): Bears that really care for others learn that not everyone wants to be cared for, no matter how much positivity they exude.
- Velvet (2019): Ballroom-inspired (or at least composer's impression of a ballroom) solo piano piece inspired by the material and the color.
- Velvetine (2019): Grandiose version of prior solo piano piece, Velvet. The large orchestral setup is a better fit for the scope of the original's imagination.
- Vem Kan Segla Förutan Vind? (2020): Theme and variations piece based off of the Swedish folk song and lullaby. (Waltz, then Gretchen am spinnrade + La valse d'Amélie”)
- vision (2019): Song about the singer's eyesight being poor. Allegedly, it can be solved without glasses by simply not crying to sleep.
- Warning! (2018): Dramatic, fast-paced vocalist-astrologist warns the public of dire times ahead based on planet alignment.
- Where the Forest Lies (demo) (2026): Interactive track composed for ELVTR's Music Composition for Video Games taught by Peter McConnell
- X88B88 (“XB8”) (2019): Aleatory composition which renders itself vertically composed depending on how the silences line up. Duration calculated as if each segement played once.
